data.body: **[P2] Avoid assuming exactly three operation-change batches.** The checkpoint batcher closes batches using an idle timeout, so six concurrent branches can legitimately produce a different number of `OperationChangeInfo` hooks depending on thread scheduling. The pending count may skip past 4, causing this wait and the fixed five-record assertion below to fail despite correct FIFO behavior. Record the actual hook count with a probe plugin, signal after invocation end, and assert one exported snapshot per observed start/change/end hook instead of hard-coding the count.
